title: Add Pollinations AI Studio to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Pollinations AI Studio](https://sashafilipov.github.io/pollinations-ai-studio) to build
- Multimodal workspace for Pollinations.ai вЂ” chat with GPT/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek via gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions , generate images via gen.pollinations.ai/image/{prompt} (Flux, Turbo, GPT

Fixes #12765

gist.headline: A studio grew in the garden
gist.blurb: Pollinations AI Studio has joined the build list: one cozy workspace for chatting with a small parliament of models and making images. The garden now has a desk, several buttons, and probably too many tabs.
gist.summary: Added Pollinations AI Studio to the community app build, a multimodal workspace that uses gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions for GPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek chat plus gen.pollinations.ai/image/{prompt} for Flux, Turbo, and GPT image generation.
gist.impact: People can now discover Pollinations AI Studio as a single workspace for switching between supported chat models and generating images through Pollinations endpoints.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a welcoming pixel-art creative studio in a garden: a retro workstation with several small chat windows and an image canvas, surrounded by flowering code-plants. Polli is actively arranging model cards and paint-like pixels on the desk, wearing a tiny artist beret; the CRT Monitor Robot eagerly watches the workspace display.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden studio with a retro computer desk showing small chat panels labeled GPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek beside a glowing image canvas, with code-plants and pastel flowers growing around it. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny painter's beret and arranges colorful pixel art on the desk beside a cute chunky CRT-monitor robot. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle CRT glow, emotionally warm.
